tldr: Scorpio rising: intense, private, and impossible to read casually.
body: With Scorpio rising, you meet life through depth, instinct, and a need to know what is real beneath the surface. Your path asks you to use perception without turning every room into a threat assessment.
approach: Protects energy, detects hidden motives, and commits fully once trust is earned.
shadow: Suspicion, control, secrecy, or testing people before letting them close.
note: Authored from approved project Big Three and sign material.
